ui.method: Full desktop cycle with final native binary and bundled pet renderer (379 passed, one skipped, five failures), followed by fixes and 73 affected/new workflow cases, one paged-position case, 11 reader/checkbox cases and three export cases including a new delayed-close regression. The newest result for each project/file/title replaces older results; overlapping cases are counted once. Eight protocol cases use an isolated catalog fixture. All five full-cycle failures have passing final results; this is composed acceptance, not a claim that one final monolithic run passed.
